text:
olivia: quick note — saw a weird cluster where project-scoped keys are being billed to the org. small % but shows up on quota spikes for 3 tenants.

ram: do we know whether the project claim is lost before auth exchange or during token mint?

josh: traced a sample — incoming header has project, exchanged token from auth-service omitted project field. edge preserved header.

maya: sounds like the compatibility exchange path in auth-service is dropping the claim for some model pools. we added that to avoid rejects on older backends.

sarah: customers see org billing with no trace. console needs a breadcrumb — "routing.exchange=compat_strip" or similar — so they know why attribution changed.

olivia: agreed. telemetry proposal: add `auth.exchange_project_present:true|false` and `routing.fallback_variant:primary|compat_strip|cost_opt`. keep original header for 48h (scrubbed) for debugging. legal already ok for short TTL.

ram: ops: add tenant-level flag `auth.preserve_project=true` for canary. default remains strip-on-reject.

josh: canary plan: enable preserve_project for 4 internal orgs, monitor `model_reject_rate` and `auth.exchange_project_present`. rollback if rejects > 0.5% or latency +p50 >50ms.

sarah: UX: on quota page show small indicator next to spikes "Routing used: compat_strip" with a link to traces and an opt-in button to prefer project attribution. keep copy short and link to docs.

deploy-bot: canary started at 1812350100 for orgs [redwood-internal-a, redwood-internal-b]; watching metrics channel.

maya: I'll add the telemetry labels and a quick Kibana panel. josh, please own canary toggles and the rollback checklist.

josh: got it — will post results in 6h. if model rejects spike, we'll fallback to the old strip path immediately.

olivia: thanks team — aim to have console tooltip and heatmap preview before we consider wider rollout.
